library_title: Kelvin6K Robot Component and Machine Reference Library
description: Master manifest of approved robot component references, whole-machine visual photographs, and technical specification sources.

roles_and_categories.robot_reference: Whole-machine appearance and configuration photographs. Useful for overview and general visual explanation. Cannot identify internal electronics or fine wiring.
roles_and_categories.component_reference: Component-specific engineering schematics, CAD representations, and verified part diagrams for targeted troubleshooting.
roles_and_categories.technical_spec_source: Source tables and specification document captures establishing official mechanical, electrical, and safety ratings.
roles_and_categories.incident_original: Runtime photograph uploaded by an operator during printing defect troubleshooting.
roles_and_categories.incident_annotation: Machine-generated visual observation and defect bounding-box overlay derived from an incident original.

assets.display_title: Kelvin6K Precision Print Nozzle & Extruder Assembly
assets.caption: Kelvin6K-V2 40mm Print Nozzle Assembly and Standoff Calibration Collar
assets.relevance_explanation: Extrusion gaps, voids, and bead irregularities commonly stem from hardened concrete buildup, nozzle clogging, or incorrect standoff distance at the nozzle tip.
assets.keywords: nozzle orifice tip standoff extruder gap void under-extrusion flow bead clog blockage irregular deformation build-up build up narrow printhead print head mounted mount
assets.limitations: Component CAD schematic. Physical inspection required to verify nozzle wear and orifice clearance.

assets.display_title: Heavy-Duty Concrete Delivery Hose & Camlock Couplings
assets.caption: Kelvin6K High-Pressure 2-inch Flexible Delivery Hose with Safety-Locked Camlock Fittings
assets.relevance_explanation: Inconsistent material delivery and sudden bead starvation frequently result from delivery line choking, aggregate buildup, or line leakage.
assets.keywords: hose delivery line camlock choke choking clog material not coming pressure burst joint coupling hosepipe feed tube routing feed tube
assets.limitations: Reference schematic. Visual checks cannot measure internal hose wall thinning or hardened core plugs.

assets.display_title: Progressive Cavity Concrete Pump Unit & Pressure Manifold
assets.caption: Kelvin6K Progressive Cavity Mortar Pump with Digital Pressure Sensor Manifold
assets.relevance_explanation: Total extrusion stoppages, low flow alarms, and pressure surges typically indicate rotor/stator wear, dosing drive trip, or ESP signal interruption.
assets.keywords: pump booster pump dosing pump stator rotor pressure flow surge stopped stopped running pump trip
assets.limitations: Reference schematic. Motor electrical trip, stator rubber debonding, and pressure sensor drift must be verified by multimeter and pressure gauge.

assets.display_title: Material Intake Hopper with Safety Grating
assets.caption: Kelvin6K 200L Material Intake Hopper with Safety Screen and Ultrasonic Level Monitor
assets.relevance_explanation: Intermittent starvation, dry-mix lumps, or cavitation voids originate from hopper bridging or dry material level dropping below the intake throat.
assets.keywords: hopper dry mix intake grating lumps level bridging bin funnel strainer
assets.limitations: Reference schematic. Visual reference does not confirm ultrasonic sensor calibration.

assets.display_title: Chemical Accelerator Dosing Unit & Injector Assembly
assets.caption: Kelvin6K Precision Peristaltic Accelerator Dosing Pump and In-Line Injector Ring
assets.relevance_explanation: Layer slumping, wall collapse at corners, or rapid curing nozzle blockages are directly tied to chemical accelerator dosing ratio and injector condition.
assets.keywords: accelerator chemical dosing injector slump slumping collapse setting curing quick fast hardening admixture
assets.limitations: Reference diagram. Peristaltic tube elasticity and needle valve blockage require physical inspection.

assets.display_title: Multi-Axis AC Servo Drive Rack (E08.5 / E136.1 / E137.1)
assets.caption: Kelvin6K Multi-Axis Digital AC Servo Amplifier Rack with Diagnostic LED Display
assets.relevance_explanation: Motion interruptions, axis positioning faults, or print height deviation indicate servo drive overload, encoder communication loss, or travel limit trips.
assets.keywords: servo drive axis encoder error e08.5 e136.1 e137.1 alarm motion gantry amplifier y-axis z-axis
assets.limitations: Hardware reference schematic. Specific drive fault code (e.g. E08.5 vs E136.1) must be read from the physical 7-segment LED display or bus diagnostics.
